content.title: OT-GV (Olde Town Grandview) District
content.summary: The Olde Town Grandview zoning district in Arvada aims to preserve the historic character of the area while allowing for a variety of uses, including mixed-use developments, single-family homes, and civic buildings. The district permits specific residential, hospitality, commercial, and community uses, with certain classifications allowed by-right or with limitations, as outlined in the Land Development Code.
content.body:
The intent of the Olde Town form-based zoning districts is to protect the established historic character of Olde Town Arvada based on the City's adopted plans and design guidelines for the area. The Olde Town Grandview zoning district is a mixed-use zone district allowing mixed-use, single-family dwelling, duplex, accessory building and civic building form types.

Acronyms:

- Allowed Use By-Right (A)
- Limited Use (L)
- Conditional Use (C)

**Note**: If a use is not listed in the table then it is not allowed in the zoning district
